rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the practical usefulness of something, rather than specifically asking whether it can be done.

example.english: The practicality of this design is very high.
example.traditional: 呢個設計夠簡單，實用性好高。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 cit3 gai3 gau3 gaan2 daan1 sat6 jung6 sing3 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this when practicality means whether a plan or proposal is feasible.

example.english: The committee will first assess the practicality of the proposal.
example.traditional: 委員會會先評估方案嘅可行性。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui2 wui5 sin1 ping4 gu2 fong1 on3 ge3 ho2 hang4 sing3

rows.note: Use this for the practical side of a matter, rather than its usefulness or feasibility as a whole.

example.english: This report sounds good in theory, but its practicality still needs more thought.
example.traditional: 呢份報告理論講得好靚，但實際方面仲要再諗吓。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 lei5 leon6 gong2 dak1 hou2 leng3 daan6 sat6 zai3 fong1 min6 zung6 jiu3 zoi3 nam2 haa5
